text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Some 100 companies to take part in Egyptian products' fair to be held in Kuwait in May 1997.
- Official says new housing projects to be launched in Kuwait.
- Emir of Kuwait Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah congratulates world leaders on the new year.
- Planning Ministry completes draft on government work plan.
- Minister of Social Affairs and Labour Ahmad al-Kulaib toughens measures to ensure prompt payment of salaries by private companies.
- Ministry of Commerce and Industry says it will not allow prices to shoot up during the Moslem holy fasting month.
- Citizens demand more action for release of Kuwaitis detained in Iraq.
